notes.title: New adventure begins... Dreamspring.
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3231480/Dreamspring/][h2]Dreamspring...[/h2][/url] 
A new project which has been long in the works is finally announced. While it may seem similar to Necroslayer, nearly every system has been rewritten from the ground up. New weapon, quest, codex, inventory systems, and much more.

Play testing will begin shortly and a demo is planned for February. If this new project seems interesting to you, feel free to add it to your wishlist and try the demo when it's ready. 

If these new systems are popular enough and the demand is there, then Necroslayer may get a new update to reflect this new system. Let me know if that's something you'd like to see.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3231480/Dreamspring/]Check out Dreamspring Steam page here.[/url]

notes.title: v1.0.8 Bug fixes and new side quest
notes.content:
Thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@daniccus]Daniccus[/url], who recently started a series on YouTube for the game which has helped uncover a few bugs. He also discovered a secret in his second video, good job!

Fixes for v1.0.8:
-Swimming no longer strobes above the surface.
-Reduced intense lighting in many caves.
-A short side quest in Mara revolving around an imposter.

notes.title: v1.0.7 Dash is now middle mouse button
notes.content:
-Due to some suggestions, dash is now middle mouse button.
-Adds partial controller support for the game. This is for game testers to give feed back. Currently only the player's manual will display buttons. Settings and dialogue options are known to not work with controller. Controller support will continue to improve in future updates.
-Fixed Soul Stone menu bug.

notes.title: Player Map Marker and fixes
notes.content:
-Map in the pause menu now displays your player location.
-Fixed relic chests from respawning repeatedly in Necromancer's Lair.
-Fixed area in Stonewood Pass to prevent getting stuck.

notes.title: Inverted Y Axis option
notes.content: As per request, you can now invert the vertical look axis in the settings.

notes.title: Weapon Bar Update
notes.content: New weapon bar that displays weapons upon switching. This will make it easier to know what weapons you can equip and what their hotkey number is. Update also includes many UI tweaks and a bug fix for Dahkil's quest.

notes.title: v1.0.3 bug fixes and additions
notes.content:
-UI color adjustments.
-Tutorial reworks.
-Continue game now displays previous character and level.
-Fixed bug with fire dragon kill not saving.

notes.title: v1.0.2 bug fixes
notes.content:
-Fixed floating bricks in the final dungeon.
-Soul Stone mention in Player's Manuel.
-End game dialogue fixed.

notes.title: v1.0.1 bug fixes
notes.content:
-Added some new LODs to improve FPS.
-Player no longer moves in character select upon starting a new game.
-New page in the player's manual explaining meta progression.

notes.title: Full Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599244/ff07b71de6ba1b76cf63ca31e274b0563086515f.png[/img]

Thank you to all who play tested and reported issues.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
-Potion buttons no longer fail to activate.
-Tutorials can now be turned off in the settings menu.
-Fixed a bug that made the player slide on death.

notes.title: FPS Improvement Patch
notes.content:
This update should fix many known areas where FPS would tank. Maximized occlusion culling for all objects on the maps. Some scripts have been removed and others have been fixed for better performance.

Please report if FPS has improved or not. Issues will vary for individual players. Some people are experiencing no issues, others are struggling in random areas.

notes.title: Hotfixes
notes.content:
Last update broke tutorials around town. There's a new hotfix which fixes that.

Mage attack has also been fixed from a three round burst to a stream of bolts.

Even upon leaving early access, bugs and issues will always be fixed, but they must be reported and I'll need more information. Please reach out to me and I'll likely ask for more information to be able to fix the issue. Not everyone will have the same issues, there are examples of YouTubers who have played Necroslayer with minimal to no issues.

notes.title: Nearing full game release
notes.content:
This is a massive update with many additions and overhauls to the game. This is bringing the game close to leaving early access, as most of the content planned has been added and bug reports have been fixed. As always, please report any new bugs in the steam community or the discord.

Player changes:
Level cap changed from 40 to unlimited.
Weapon upgrade points are now 1 per 3 levels.
New revive potion, able to bring back the player upon a potential death.

World changes:
New lower Vagre map: opened after helping Ghilt in Stormhold. Every playthrough you can visit Vagre for a random additional ghost weapon and regular weapon for purchase at the shops.
New Abandoned City map: A new dungeon area with a relic weapon for Mysana at the end.
New music tracks: northern and western maps now have a new track each, as well as a new track for inside the Vagre castle map.
Town overhaul, new side quests, houses reworked, lighting changes.
New animals to the maps. Farm animals on the Fay Meadows farm, deer to be found in the North Plains.
Added weapon upgrade points to be found on maps.
Inner City Nekropolis additions.
New dungeon under Mara's tavern and well.

Aesthetic changes:
UI overhaul including new ingame cursor and menu polish.
New world map to the pause menu.

notes.title: Large Update for Polish/Fixes
notes.content:
Player changes:
-Pressing block now queues up after attacks, improving the flow of combat.
-Mysana's siphon spell is now twice as fast.
-Most weapons now reach longer on attack.
-Every new game starts off with one life and mana potion.
-Player torch illumination adjusted with less glow making it more visible.

Enemy changes:
-New enemies in hard mode. 
-Zombie warriors have red magic sword spells in normal mode, double swords in hard mode.

World changes:
-New ghost texture shaders.
-Swimming in the north plains, dive into the water now!
-Dahkil's assistant quest updated.
-Many stair collisions reworked that weren't working well with new player controller.
-Dialogue stays on screen if you remain close to NPC after talking to them.
-Window shader rework.
-Tutorial additions.
-Typos fixes, sound reworks, and other bug fixes.

notes.title: Player controller overhaul!
notes.content:
All new player controller changing how the game is played.
-New ability to dash, allowing you to easily break pots or knockback enemies.
-Ability to auto sprint.
-All new smooth look camera and movement, as well as camera bob.
-Crouch and swim has been integrated.

-New tutorials and alert messages when entering harder maps.
-Greatsword now shoots fireballs on bash at level 2 and 3.
-Fixed Ashland outpost shops.
-New details to Old Road and Mara.
-Multiple bug fixes.

notes.title: Sound overhaul
notes.content:
-Enemy magic auras make noises, enemies now have footsteps at close range that change on different terrains, and even splash through water when walking in it.
-Fixed Matriarch's dialogue.
-Fire skeleton weapons now despawn properly.

notes.title: Grain removal in settings.
notes.content: You can now turn off grain visuals in the settings.

notes.title: New content and fixes
notes.content:
-Several new areas added with ice and fire dragon battles to be found, along with the home of the dark elves.
-Three new achievements related to the added areas.
-New effects for all weapons per level.
-Button descriptions display on mouse over in all menus.
-Fixed bug that removed tutorials from town.
-Ultra Hard mode removed.

notes.title: Sound overhaul
notes.content: Major sound overhaul included in this update. A major bug making evil magic one hit the player with or without protection has been fixed. Plus several small fixes such as enemy body parts despawning quicker, several small typos, and more.

notes.title: Hotfix with additions
notes.content:
-Fixed Ashland outpost teleport portal from freezing game upon loading.
-Added hordes to Ashlands map, plus more detail and changes to the map.

notes.title: Improvement update
notes.content:
-Controller support removed. 
-Controls changed for more fluent gameplay.
-Three new achievements:
    Gaining evil magic protection in Stormhold.
    Performing ten parries.
    Defeating the undead horde in north plains.
-New events and enemies on the way back from Stormhold.
-Final tower additions with new unique relic chest.
-Soul requirement for soul stone upgrades nerfed.
-Teleport stones which were exclusive to hard mode or higher are now available in easy/normal mode.
-Weapon upgrade damage output increased.
-Max potions capacity increased per game difficulty finished.
-New low level mobs in north plains and north road.
-Enemies in graveyard map now slightly nerfed.
-Small UI tweaks.
-Additional tutorials.
-New messages and animations for main quest events.
-Fixed bug that allowed activation of ghost bar early.

notes.title: Bug fixes and polish
notes.content:
-Resetting game will properly reset passive weapons.
-Path grids fixed in Stormhold.
-Fixed Grayrock Ruins relic chests.
-Passive weapons no longer play sound while loading scenes.
-Added the Old Mine map, to be expanded upon in the next update.

notes.title: Content update
notes.content:
New maps:
Big new open world maps with frozen enemies to the far north and burning flame enemies to the west. They will be resistant or weak to magic depending on their type. On these maps are new quests, dungeons and relics to find.

More dynamic movement with magic enemies:
Some of the magic enemies used to move far away from the player and never return, now they're more dynamic and move away/closer depending on the player actions.

Small changes:
-Greatsword overhaul, fire attacks benefit against ice enemies.
-Polearm rework, ice attacks benefit against fire enemies.
-New relic chests that guarantee a relic you don't have.
-Numbers now used as hotkeys for weapons.
-Ghost magic won't drain spirit while zoning.
-Changes to lighting.
-Many small sound adjustments and volume changes.

Bug fixes:
Ashlands portal fixed.

notes.title: Hotfixes and improvements
notes.content:
-Greatsword magic visual improvements.
-Polearm damage reworked.
-Inventory tool tips added.
-Better armor rolls in higher difficulties.
-Adjusted dead skeleton part collision boxes.
-Fixed a bug where magic no longer damaged player after last big script overhaul.

notes.title: Upgraded post processing and magic effects
notes.content:
Reworked the post processing to look more like a real 80's dark fantasy style cinematic experience.

Reworked some of the magic effects on enemies to look more higher quality.

notes.title: Save and Continue
notes.content: New save system allows you to start where you left off with your stats, equipment and world progress where ever you were on the map. As long as you don't die, you can quit at any time and continue next time you play. Loading scenes or bringing up the pause menu trigger the auto save. No manual saving necessary.

notes.title: Loading and animation overhaul with several new additions.
notes.content:
Large overhaul to loading scenes, removing bugs that can cause loading issues over long periods.

Animation overhauls for enemies, making transitions smoother.

Increased souls gain in harder difficulties and a new teleport system for hard modes only.

New compass, many small bugs fixes, and small details added.

notes.title: Hotfix with animation and loading
notes.content: Quick fix to a broken cell, as well as adding animations to characters.

notes.title: Combat fixed and reworks.
notes.content:
Reworked a few weapons which were swinging a bit too low. Now they all hit through the crosshair and have a wider range to hit. 

Some passive weapons were reworked to be more useful and hit more frequently.

notes.title: Update notes for December 10th, 2023
notes.content: Controller hotfix.

notes.title: Necroslayer is now live!
notes.content: The game is now live in early access and the main story is fully playable! Currently there's a few side quests, side dungeons, one alternate ending and nine playable characters. The plan is to keep it in early access for about 6 months and finalize any changes before then. But at the moment the game is playable from beginning to end. There is much more planned, and any feedback will be considered for changes in the full version. You can visit the Discord, Steam community, or leave a detailed review on Steam to help improve the game.
